entities.name: Christ the Saviour Cathedral, Taichung
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Christ the Saviour Cathedral also called Cathedral of Jesus Saviour is a religious building that is affiliated with the Catholic Church and is located at 100 Sanmin street in Central District, Taichung, Taiwan, Island. The present church building began in 1957 and was completed in 1958.
